bind_port.description: The DNS service port (typically 53 for standard DNS).

bind_listen_on_ipv4.description: Enable listening for IPv4 DNS queries.

bind_listen_on.description: List of IPv4 addresses to listen on for DNS queries.

bind_listen_on_ipv6.description: Enable listening for IPv6 DNS queries.

bind_listen_on_v6.description: List of IPv6 addresses to listen on for DNS queries.

bind_directory.description: Working directory for the DNS server (where zone files are stored by default).

bind_pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the named process.

bind_recursion.description: Allow recursive queries (required for forwarder/resolver operation).

bind_allow_query.description: List of ACLs or IP ranges permitted to submit queries.

bind_forwarders.description: List of upstream DNS servers to forward queries to (if recursion is enabled).

bind_forward_only.description: When forwarding, only forward (don’t try root resolution if forwarder fails).

bind_dnssec_validation.description: Enable DNSSEC validation (set to false to disable).

bind_accept_foreign.description: Accept non-authoritative answers from upstream servers (for stub zones or special setups).

bind_logging_channels.description: List of logging channel definitions. Each item defines where and how to log.

file.description: Path to log file (if omitted, uses syslog/null)

versions.description: Number of rotated files to keep

bind_logging_categories.description: List of log categories and the channels they bind to.

channels.description: List of channel names to route this category's logs to

bind_acls.description: Define access control lists (ACLs) for reuse in allow-query/transfer/etc.

items.description: List of IP addresses, networks, or named ACLs

bind_trusted_keys.description: List of DNSSEC trusted keys (used for trust anchor validation).

bind_zones.description: List of authoritative zones to serve (master/slave/hint/stub).

file.description: Zone data file path (relative to 'directory' if not absolute)

masters.description: List of master server IPs (required for slave/stub)

allow_query.description: Override global allow-query for this zone

allow_transfer.description: Allow zone transfers to specific IPs/ACLs

notify.description: Send DNS NOTIFY messages to slaves

check_names.description: Behavior on zone file name checks: 'warn', 'fail', 'ignore'

match_destinations.description: ACLs to match server interface addresses

match_query_sources.description: ACLs to match client source addresses

recursion.description: Override global recursion setting for this view

zones.description: Zone definitions specific to this view
